data.name: Sudharsan
data.gender_notes: Sudharsan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who has a good eye or a good vision, always looking at the good things in life and protecting his loved ones. The name Sudharsan carries the meaning “Good Eye” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sudharsan usually hope their child will grow to embody good eye and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who have a deep inner wisdom and always look at the good in every situation.
data.etymology: Sudharsan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good Eye.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sudharsan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sudharsan stands out in Indian mythology, where this deity is often depicted wearing a rosary, holding a conch, discus, and a star-shaped chakra. The name refers to a person who always has a clear vision of the good in life and uses this vision to protect their loved ones. In Hindu tradition, wearing the Sudharsan symbol is believed to bring good luck and prosperity.
data.spiritual_significance: In Indian spirituality, the name Sudharsan reflects the idea of the inner seer or the wise observer within us. It is a reminder to seek out the good vision or the higher purpose in our lives, and to use this inner vision to navigate through challenges and protect the spiritual well-being of ourselves and those around us. The name also symbolizes the power of protection and security that comes from having a clear and righteous vision.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sudharsan: Pure Vision. One who sees the world through the pure lens of consciousness, untouched by illusion or impurity.
